title: Unlocking a device by performing gestures on an unlock image
abstract: A method controls an electronic device with a touch-sensitive display by detecting contact while in a locked state, moving an image according to the contact, and transitioning to an unlocked state if the contact matches a predefined gesture. The device displays visual cues and unlock images on the touch screen. When a user performs the correct gesture with respect to the unlock image—such as dragging it to a predefined location or along a predefined path—the device transitions to the unlock state. Multiple unlock images can correspond to different applications or events, allowing users to unlock directly to specific functions.
gist: Apple's slide-to-unlock patent: on a locked touch-screen device, dragging an on-screen image along a predefined path unlocks it, with animated visual cues showing the way. The gesture prevents accidental activation while staying instantly discoverable.
